references.text: Samson's wife was given to his companion, which is the background for the father's claim in 15:2 that he thought Samson hated her.
Laban gave his younger daughter Rachel to Jacob instead of the older Leah, a similar case where a father swaps daughters in marriage arrangements.
Saul promised his daughter Merab to David but gave her to another man, and then offered his younger daughter Michal—a similar pattern of swapping daughters.
The comparison between sisters where one is described as better or more beautiful than the other, just as the father here claims that the younger sister is more beautiful.
